title: Indian-Style Fish Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy Indian-inspired dish featuring fish skewers marinated in a mixture of yellow and turmeric.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend together yellow chilies, turmeric powder, lemon juice, ginger paste, and garlic until smooth.
Cut the fish into 1-inch pieces and add to the marinade. Mix well and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread marinated fish onto skewers.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
